title: pain.001.001.09 Payment Composer & Preparation Receipt
description: Author a multi-payment pain.001.001.09 credit-transfer initiation message with a debtor header form and payment-row grid, live per-field schema-subset validation (IBAN mod-97, BIC format, ISO 4217/3166, decimal/date facets), canonical byte-stable XML serialization, and a preparation receipt (message digest, validation report digest, control totals, prepared-not-transmitted flag). Subset validation, not full XSD conformance. Does not transmit live payments.

mcp_tool_definition.name: pain001_compose
mcp_tool_definition.description: Composes a multi-payment pain.001.001.09 credit-transfer initiation message from a debtor header and an array of payment rows, validating each field against the hand-derived schema-subset table (IBAN mod-97, BIC format, ISO 4217/3166 membership, decimal/date facets, Max35/Max140Text), then serializes canonical byte-stable XML and returns a preparation receipt (message digest, validation report digest, control sum, transaction count, prepared-not-transmitted flag). Subset validation, not full XSD conformance. Does not transmit live payments.
